description: Charming house with character in the heart of Paris, combining the charm of the old with modern comfort.It has 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms with toilets, a fully equipped kitchen, a living room, a dining room and 2 balconies.Ideally located near the Marais and Bastille, with shops, restaurants, markets, metro, buses, taxis and Vélib' within walking distance.Perfect for families, groups of friends or business travellers. Park with playground nearby.The spaceThe accommodationThis spacious and bright apartment is located on the first floor of a magnificent Parisian building with character. Quiet and comfortable, it is ideal for families, groups of friends or business travellers who want to stay together while maintaining their privacy.Composition of the accommodation:* 5 bedrooms* 3 bathrooms with WC (each pair of bedrooms has direct access to a bathroom – see plan)* Large living room* Dining room* Fully equipped kitchen* 2 balconies* Laundry room with washing machine and dryerThe bedroomsAll rooms have:* High-end bedding* Cotton or linen bed linen* Safe* Wardrobe and storage* Winter: Heating* Summer: Portable air conditioners, portable fans or ceiling fans* Authentic Parisian decorBed configurationBedroom 1* 1 double bed (180 x 200 cm) or 2 single beds (90 x 200 cm)* Please let us know your preference before your arrival* Balcony* Direct access to a bathroom with toiletBedroom 2* 1 single bed (80 x 190 cm)* Option to add a second single bed* Direct access to a bathroom with toiletBedroom 3* 1 double bed (160 x 190 cm)* Direct access to a bathroom with toiletBedroom 4* 1 double bed (160 x 190 cm)* Direct access to a bathroom with toiletBedroom 5* 1 single bed (80 x 190 cm)* Option to add a second single bed* Balcony* Direct access to a bathroom with toiletTravelling with a baby
